# clio compliance review-export

Write the ordered local review events to a content-free file under destination custody (requires --actor harness|system)

## Usage

```
clio compliance review-export --out FILE [--limit N] [--cursor C] [--bank BANK] [--actor ACTOR] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

writes the ordered local review events as content-free rows (sequence position, action id, state) under durable destination custody: the destination is recorded pending before any bytes land, an existing file is never overwritten, and only a harness or system actor may export

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out FILE` | text |  | Names the review file to write; `cli_write_portability::run_review_export` passes it to the `review_export` tool as `destination`, which refuses to overwrite an existing caller file; the destination must lie inside the deployment export root, a relative path is joined to that root, and a path outside it is refused: the root is `CLIO_EXPORT_ROOT` when it is set, else `<data directory>/exports`, else `<working directory>/clio-exports`. |
| `--limit N` | text |  | Bounds the review page to N rows; `cli_write_portability::run_review_export` passes it as `limit`, and the tool applies its own default when omitted. |
| `--cursor C` | text |  | Resumes the review after this decimal sequence position; `cli_write_portability::run_review_export` passes it as `cursor`. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Write the review file under destination custody.
```
clio compliance review-export --out review.txt --actor harness
```

Write a bounded review page and emit JSON.
```
clio compliance review-export --out review.txt --limit 100 --actor system -o json
```
